summary: Gladys Assistant is a privacy-first, self-hosted home automation server (Express + Sequelize/SQLite): it persists users, sessions, houses, rooms, areas, devices and their feature/state history, scenes and their tags, calendars and events, dashboards and assets, variables, chat messages, background jobs, services, and energy prices, and exposes them through a REST API with token sessions.

_dropped_unexpressible.reason: Writes DeviceFeature.energy_parent_id, an id-FK column; runtime field_set excludes id-type columns and relation_link fk-branch cannot resolve the object key -> permanent silent no-op (probe flagged no_op).
Core write is User.current_house_id, an id-FK column unexpressible by field_set for the same reason; its last_house_changed half alone would be a misleading partial write.

Bulk position re-order of several dashboards by an index list; not expressible in one row-targeted field_set, and the pre-pass panel exposed every Dashboard column as a bypass. Dropped rather than ship a broad write.
